webhooks.detail: Incoming webhook endpoint per bot (POST /bots/{BOT_UNIQUE_NAME}/incoming); webhook-type bots delegate handler execution to an external server (outbound event delivery via bot handlers). No generic REST event-subscription API found.

evidence.quote: A Webhook bot delegates all handler execution to your own external server.

sandbox.detail: Cliq has a Free plan (pricing page) and the developer platform (Deluge bots, commands, extensions) is documented, but I could not verify in docs that the free tier includes API/developer-platform access or a dedicated sandbox. platform page returned 403 to fetch.

evidence.quote: Cliq provides a platform for building internal tools

rate_limits.summary: ~15-20 requests/min per authenticated user; 10-min lock on 429

evidence.quote: Most Zoho Cliq APIs have rate limits of 15-20 requests per minute per user
Deluge, which is the default programming environment supported by Cliq
